title: [Settings/Runner] Failing to load a module will wipe its entry in settings

judgment.rationale: An open upstream PR explicitly closes this issue and describes preserving enabled settings for modules that fail to load. It also fixes the related shutdown persistence issue; a competing design would duplicate active work.
evidence: PR 50897 is open, non-draft, and its checklist explicitly says it closes #50853.
PR 50897 states that Runner previously rebuilt enabled settings only from successfully loaded modules, dropping saved state for modules that failed to load.
The PR changes src/runner/general_settings.cpp and removes the Runner-exit save in src/runner/main.cpp; its body describes preserving saved state for missing modules and persisting user changes.
